programs.title: Bamay
programs.desc: Over three parts, we venture to Kalkadoon Country in Mount Isa, QLD. Known for rugged landscapes and rich Indigenous heritage, this region offers a unique glimpse into the heart of the Aussie outback.

programs.title: Toi Time
programs.desc: The Toi Time whanau celebrate Oma's birthday. Aunty Anika bakes the birthday cake and Buzz makes a beautiful bunch of putiputi for Oma.

programs.title: Waabiny Time
programs.desc: Join Kylie Farmer and Lee West to explore what it was like growing up in the bush and the traditional ways of Noongar culture.

programs.title: Birds Eye View
programs.desc: There's a bird trapped inside a cage inside the human's house. Holy Heka! It's time to break that jailbird out.

programs.title: Aussie Bush Tales
programs.desc: Moort is concerned that the creatures will eat all the fish and that there will be none left for dinner. How will they share the fish with so many animals?

programs.title: The Mysterious Cities Of Gold
programs.desc: The one who attacked Esteban, Tao and Zia is Yoshi, an old man who fiercely keeps the impressive Orichalcum sphere. Yoshi reveals the children that it's a utsuro bune, a revered sacred object.

programs.title: Bushwhacked
programs.desc: Kayne and Kamil are on a journey to the Epping Forest National Park in central Queensland to meet the once thought extinct, but still critically endangered, Hairy-Nosed Wombat.

programs.title: Motown Magic
programs.sub_title: Stop In The Name Of Love And I Wish
programs.desc: Friendship fears surface as Mickey pulls away, but talking it through brings the group closer. / Plus, a wistful journey about holding onto childhood while embracing the now.

programs.title: The Magic Canoe
programs.desc: While Pam is unhappy to be told that she is too small to do anything, Viola sends the campers on a surprise mission!

programs.title: Spartakus And The Sun Beneath The Sea
programs.desc: The Athenian orator Demosthenes seems to know the way to Arkadia. But Maxagaze, who wants to learn public speaking in hopes of winning the next pirate elections, needs his services.

programs.title: The World According To Grandpa
programs.sub_title: What Happened To All The Dinosaurs
programs.desc: Connie asks 'What happened to the dinosaurs?' and Grandpa spins a tall tale about the world's biggest game of hide-and-seek between all the world's dinosaurs and all the world's mice!

programs.title: Chums
programs.desc: Turtles begin to appear everywhere causing chaos, the Chums must help the turtles find their home by the creek.
